name: Universal AI
scope: Evaluate the AI bundle component by component for unique useful behaviour and potential CBE integration. Cherry-pick, combine, fix and improve AI intent; no wholesale bundle import, automatic dependency or parity claim.
identityEvidence: User-supplied Workshop URL and matching installed folder; mod.cpp/meta.cpp read. Both meta.cpp files have publishedid0, so local metadata is not independent confirmation of Workshop binding. Workshop page inaccessible through browser tool; first ID search returned no result.
evaluationTopics: Inventory and hash all packaged components; identify original upstream references, versions, licences and attribution before reuse.

Deduplicate already registered or implemented HBQ/LAMBS/driving/CQB/turret/drone/information-sharing methods by exact source/hash comparison before counting new work. Component filenames are discovery hints, not proven feature scope.

Review relevant AI movement, driving, combat, sensing/sharing, vehicle/turret and aircraft/drone behaviour plus actual registration and callback lifetimes. Prioritise useful unique AI portions; optional player/UI/assets are outside automatic scope.

Resolve competing FSM/controllers and settings/skills writers through existing CBE owners, mission authority and compare-with-applied restoration. Avoid stacked controllers or mission-skill overrides.
Preserve foundations-first ordering, compatibility-last policy, IKMS/WBK compatibility-only scope, finite cleanup/locality, credible animation and measured performance.
dependencies: UNVERIFIED; inspect actual addon configuration/registration and runtime calls.
licence: UNVERIFIED; establish original upstream and component-specific reuse rights before incorporating code.
sourceProtection: Installed originals/signatures/assets and preserved references are read-only; do not edit/repack/execute source addons or include raw reference code/assets in product. Use separately dated private extracts for later review.
sourceReview: NOT_STARTED; package presence/hashes and metadata only. No extraction, execution, source parity, feature implementation or physical acceptance claimed.
ordering: After current foundations/FSM work, following source register; merge selected AI methods through existing owners. Compatibility expansion remains last.
masterLedger: Historical LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.md absent; tracked intake and recoverable source-review map preserve this request.
bundleBoundary: 41 PBO component filenames observed, including hbq_advanced_driving_ai and lambs_rpg/lambs_turrets families. Exact duplication, versions, source scope and original authorship remain unverified. Do not treat compilation authorship as rights to every component.
